title.narrative: Perform, Produce, Design: Reviving cultural heritage, artistic expression and creative industries

description.narrative: This intervention was designed in partnership with the Goethe Institute (lead entrusted entity) and the British Council (implementing partner) on behalf of EUNIC (EU National Institutes for Culture) cluster in Palestine as part of the Action Document `Support to Culture in Palestine¿. The project is composed of three major arts and cultural outputs that are interrelated and complementary to one another. These include 1) a site-specific performance festival and 2) an arts residency programme in cultural heritage sites, and 3) a Palestinian design intervention.
